operations.contract: Unweighted nonlinear least squares, analytic Jacobian and damped scaled Gauss-Newton (Levenberg-Marquardt). n > number of coefficients. max_iter 1..5000, tolerance 1e-12..1e-3. May converge to a local optimum. Covariance sigma_squared * inverse(J transpose J), when locally full rank, conditional on the supplied family. No bounds or arbitrary formula language.
operations.description: Nonlinear residual least squares, 10 curve families: [x,y] rows; [family0..9,max_iterations=300,tolerance=1e-9,optional_initial_coefficients...].

operations.contract: Cox-de Boor recurrence, degree 1..3; full nondecreasing knot vector with degree+1 equal endpoint knots; interior multiplicity <= degree; <=64 basis columns. Queries outside closed knot domain rejected.
operations.description: Clamped Cox-de Boor B-spline basis: [x] rows; [degree1..3,full_clamped_knots...].

operations.contract: B-spline regression minimizes SSE + lambda*sum(second coefficient differences squared). n > basis count; rank deficient penalized information rejected. Returns exact smoother effective df trace(S), variance df n-2trace(S)+trace(S squared), and conditional sandwich covariance. This is a P-spline; it is not JMP smoothing-spline lambda or exact integrated second-derivative penalty. Response-origin offsets preserved in portable parameters.
operations.description: B-spline regression with second-difference coefficient penalty: [x,y] rows; [degree1..3,lambda,full_clamped_knots...].

operations.contract: Tricube nearest-neighbor local polynomial degree 0..2, span in (0,1], k=max(ceil(span*n),degree+2), distance at kth neighbor is bandwidth. Farthest point receives zero weight. Optional Tukey bisquare robust iterations use 6*median absolute residual. Rank deficient local fits rejected; no silent degree fallback. n<=2000. Returns training fits and portable state; no confidence interval calibration.
operations.description: Tricube local polynomial smoothing with optional robust bisquare weights: [x,y] rows; [span,degree0..2=1,robust_iterations0..10=0].

operations.contract: Reuses the saved training neighborhood and final robust weights; query rows cannot change training. Can locally extrapolate beyond training x using nearest-neighbor bandwidth.

limits: No actual JMP numerical comparison or platform equivalence claim.

Does not implement arbitrary JSL formulas, constraints, loss formulas, group-parameter comparisons, profile likelihood, dissolution equivalence, pharmacokinetic compartments, or every Fit Curve preset.
Spline penalty and LOESS span conventions are explicit contracts; they are not claimed identical to JMP defaults.
CPU only, bounded finite numeric matrices, no new dependencies.

layers.direct_C_ABI: 18040 independent NumPy/SciPy scalar assertions passed; replay harness in tasks/evidence/jmp-nonlinear-reference.json
layers.JMP_executable: not available; no numeric parity claim

common_contract.validation: Finite rectangular data, <=10000 rows, <=2 columns; <=16384 finite argument doubles. Operation-specific limits apply. Out-of-domain and rank-deficient calculations return errors.
common_contract.optimization: Local nonlinear least squares; converged:false remains explicit on unmet tolerance or objective precision limits. Automatic initial values are heuristics; supply initial parameters when the family is difficult to identify.
common_contract.uncertainty: Curve covariance requires locally full-rank Jacobian; unavailable covariance/SE are null. Standard errors are computed before squaring to preserve tiny coefficient units.
common_contract.basis_limits: B-spline degree 1..3, <=64 basis columns, full finite-width clamped knot vector, closed-domain evaluation only.
common_contract.loess_limits: <=2000 training rows; robust iterations stop if median absolute residual is exactly zero; local rank deficiency is rejected.
